For questions around nx configuration, best practices or if you're unsure, use the `nx_docs` tool to get relevant, up-to-date docs. Always use this instead of assuming things about nx configuration
If the user needs help with an Nx configuration or project graph error, use the `nx_workspace` tool to get any errors

Next.js 16 App Router, TypeScript strict, Supabase, TanStack Query v5, HeroUI v2, Tailwind CSS v4, Vitest; TJ Sokol Svinov club system. All user-facing strings must be in Czech.

Use `.claude/skills/` proactively: `/new-entity` for new table/model/CRUD (Do not scaffold files manually; invoke this skill.); `/db-sync` after DB migration or schema/type mismatch; `/new-migration` for new table, column, function, view, or RLS policy; `/generate-barrels` after adding, renaming, or removing hook/component/type/enum files (run before committing); `/review-pr` for code/PR review or “check my changes”. Follow these patterns strictly. Do not deviate without explicit user instruction.

Entity layout:
- `src/types/entities/{camelCase}/schema/{camelCase}Schema.ts` (auto-generated); `data/{camelCase}.ts` (domain types extending schema)
- `src/queries/{pluralCamel}/`: `constants.ts` (DB_TABLE + ENTITY), `queries.ts` (reads), `mutations.ts` (writes), `index.ts` (barrel)
- `src/hooks/entities/{kebab-case}/data/useFetch{Entity}s.ts`; `state/use{Entity}.ts`
- `src/lib/translations/{pluralCamel}.ts`
Client/browser: `supabaseBrowserClient()` from `@/utils/supabase/client`; server component: `supabaseServerClient()` from `@/utils/supabase/server`; authenticated API: `withAuth(handler)`; admin API: `withAdminAuth(handler)`; public API: `withPublicAccess(handler)` from `@/utils/supabase/apiHelpers`. Coach role checks: `hasCoachRole()` / `isAdmin()` / `checkCoachCardAccess()` from `@/utils/supabase/coachAuth` — these are **auth helpers, not clients**.
Never import a server client in a client component or vice versa.
Prefer `apiHelpers` wrappers over calling `supabaseServerClient()` directly in API routes — they handle auth, 401/403, and error responses consistently.
All query/mutation functions in `src/queries/` receive `ctx: QueryContext` as first argument and use `ctx.supabase`. Never call the Supabase client directly inside query files.

These files are **auto-generated** — never edit manually, always regenerate:
`src/hooks/index.ts`, `src/types/index.ts`, `src/components/index.ts`
These files are **manual** — always update by hand:
`src/lib/api-routes.ts`, `src/lib/translations/index.ts`

Component barrel generator: `scripts/generate-component-exports.mjs`. File opt-out: add `// <REDACTED_USER>` on any of first 5 lines of `.ts`/`.tsx`; folder opt-out: empty `.barrel-ignore` (e.g. `SomeComponent/utils/.barrel-ignore`). Use for non-public utility/helper files in component folders. Generator logs `⏭️  Skipping ...`.

Use layout components instead of raw Tailwind flex/grid classes. **Important:** Tailwind CSS does not support dynamic class construction (e.g. `` `flex-${direction}` ``). All layout components use static lookup maps to generate classes. Follow this pattern when creating new layout components.
Use `<Grid columns={3} gap="md">`, `<GridItem span={1}>` / `<GridItem span={2}>`, `<HStack spacing={2}>`, `<VStack spacing={4}>`; avoid manual grid/flex/space-y classes and child `col-span-X`. Files: `src/components/ui/Grid/Grid.tsx`, `src/components/ui/Grid/components/GridItem.tsx`, `src/components/ui/HStack/HStack.tsx`, `src/components/ui/VStack/VStack.tsx`, `src/components/ui/Stack/Stack.tsx`.

Use `ContentCard` by default, `Card` only for fully custom layouts. Docs: `src/components/ui/cards/CLAUDE.md`.
